title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Pre-litigation Property Preservation

articles.content_en: 1. After a People's Court accepts a party's application for pre-litigation property preservation, it shall, based on the amount of the subject matter of the pre-litigation property preservation and with reference to the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China on hierarchical jurisdiction and exclusive jurisdiction, decide to take pre-litigation property preservation measures.

2. After a People's Court that has taken property preservation measures accepts an applicant's prosecution, if it discovers that the accepted case is not within its own jurisdiction, it shall transfer the case and the property preservation application fee together to the People's Court that has jurisdiction.
After the case is transferred, the pre-litigation property preservation ruling shall remain effective.
The expenses actually incurred due to the enforcement of the pre-litigation property preservation ruling shall be refunded by the People's Court that accepted the case from the application fee to the People's Court that made the pre-litigation property preservation ruling.
This is hereby replied.
